articles.headline: Jack Grealish misses Everton-Newcastle due to 'breach of club discipline'
articles.description: Jack Grealish was made unavailable for Everton's Carabao Cup round of 16 match against Newcastle on Thursday due to what the club called a "breach of club discipline."

articles.headline: Michael Owen: I didn't get enough credit for winning Ballon d'Or
articles.description: Michael Owen has said that he doesn't believe he got the sort of credit that "others would" for winning the Ballon d'Or when he triumphed in 2001.

articles.headline: David Moyes: Everton in the Carabao Cup quarterfinals 'sounds good'
articles.description: David Moyes has said that talking about Everton in the quarterfinals of the Carabao Cup "sounds good" after his side comfortably beat Newcastle United on Thursday.

articles.headline: Everton 3-1 Newcastle: Hosts cruise into Carabao Cup quarterfinal - as it happened
articles.description: Everton set up a quarterfinal visit to Fleetwood Town with a comfortable 3-1 victory over Newcastle.

articles.headline: Everton beat Newcastle to set up Carabao quarters match with Fleetwood
articles.description: Everton set up a Carabao Cup quarterfinal against League Two Fleetwood as they eased to a 3-1 win over Newcastle United on Thursday.

articles.headline: Ranked: Every Premier League team's money-per-points (after Man City cheated)
articles.description: How much did Premier League teams spend for points -- after Man City cheated? We find out which clubs were wasteful and which spent smart.

articles.headline: Carabao Cup quarterfinal draw: Liverpool to face Bournemouth
articles.description: Liverpool will host fellow Premier League side Bournemouth in the Carabao Cup quarterfinals after making it past Chelsea in a penalty shootout on Wednesday.

articles.headline: Newcastle victory puts more scrutiny on Palace's Sage
articles.description: William Osula and Harvey Barnes scored early in the second half at Selhurst Park as Newcastle dealt Crystal Palace a frustrating 2-0 Premier League defeat to pile more pressure on Pierre Sage.

articles.headline: Crystal Palace 0-2 Newcastle United: Barnes, Osula inflict another defeat on hosts - as it happened
articles.description: A ten-minute spell in the second half saw Barnes and Osula find the net as Newcastle rose to seventh in the table with a 2-0 win over Palace.

articles.headline: Bruno Guimarães: I had sleepless nights over Arsenal move
articles.description: Bruno Guimarães has admitted he had sleepless nights over his decision to leave Newcastle United for Arsenal.

articles.headline: Referees' boss Webb backs VAR over Newcastle's Botman challenge on Villa's Jackson
articles.description: Referees boss Howard Webb believes the video assistant referee was right not to intervene after Newcastle's Sven Botman was shown a yellow card for his tackle on Aston Villa's Nicolas Jackson at the weekend.

articles.headline: Newcastle 0-1 Aston Villa: Johan Manzambi haunts Toon with first-half headed winner - as it happened
articles.description: A first-half header from Johan Manzambi was enough to give Aston Villa all three points at Newcastle on Saturday.

articles.headline: Premier League recap: Villa defeat Newcastle, Haaland with brace in Man City win
articles.description: Aston Villa were able to get a crucial away win against Newcastle, while there were more goals for Erling Haaland as Manchester City defeated Ipswich Town.

articles.headline: Johan Manzambi fires Aston Villa to victory at St. James' Park
articles.description: Johan Manzambi scored the only goal of the game as Aston Villa clinched a 1-0 win over Newcastle at St James' Park.

articles.headline: Premier League Top 50: Ranking the best players so far this season
articles.description: The Premier League Top 50 returns for the 2026-27 season to rank the best players across the league so far.

articles.headline: Johan Manzambi to haunt Newcastle? Matthias Jaissle won't be 'distracted'
articles.description: Newcastle head coach Matthias Jaissle says he is uninterested in dwelling on what might have been when highly-rated Aston Villa midfielder Johan Manzambi visits.

articles.headline: Coventry put four past Newcastle to climb out of relegation zone
articles.description: Coventry City picked up their first home victory in the Premier League for 25 years with an emphatic 4-1 win over Newcastle United on Monday.

articles.headline: Coventry City vs Newcastle: Frank Lampard's side win in emphatic style with second-half stunners - as it happened
articles.description: Frank Lampard's Coventry City earned a famous home win against Newcastle on Monday night with a devastating second-half performance seeing them come out 4-1 winners.

articles.headline: Premier League team news, injury updates after international break
articles.description: The Premier League returns this weekend after an extra-long international break. But who is injured?

articles.headline: Man City charges: What managers said about scandal ahead of Premier League return
articles.description: Here's what every Premier League manager said when asked about Manchester City's charges.
